sentences.text: 1 "(i) Release of the lands of the petitioner from the Respondent Authorities as the lands Patna High Court CWJC No.5122 of 2025(2) dt.07-04-2025 in question belonging to the petitioner and were never acquired by the Respondents without giving proper notice to the petitioners and without considering his contentions on the point of law and facts and as also without following the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, Resettlement Act.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, Resettlement Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
(ii) Setting aside all the consequential proceedings/order(s) to the extent to which it declares the Petitioners' land in Thana no.
138, khata no. 799, khesra 2645 area 688 sq feet without service of proper notice."
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the road is proposed to be constructed on his raiyati land.

4. The petitioner may raise his grievance before the District Magistrate, Samastipur (respondent no.
3), along with the documents in his favour and the District Magistrate, Samastipur shall dispose of the representation of the petitioner in accordance with law within one month after hearing the parties, without being prejudiced by this order.
5. With the aforesaid observation, this writ petition stands disposed of.
(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) Nirmal/-
